description: Pulse Wave 6.1.4 — Package isolation (com.pulsewave.music) to prevent conflicts with BeatWave, plus release build compilation fixes for Compose design elements.

changelog.title: Universal Playlist & Album Importer
items: Import playlists and albums from Spotify, Apple Music, and Amazon Music simply by pasting their public share links.
High-accuracy track matching with automatic HTML entity unescaping, cover art retrieval, and instant progress dialogs.
Batch database insertion and in-memory search query caching for blazing-fast imports without freezing playback or UI.

changelog.title: Spotify Account & Dual Wrapped Sync
items: Connect your Spotify account directly in Settings > Account alongside YouTube Music with one-tap login/logout.
Dual Wrapped Playback Sync: songs played in Pulse Wave now automatically sync with both your YouTube Music Recap and Spotify Wrapped / Recently Played.
Completely fixed Spotify Liked Songs import with robust OAuth token refreshing and multi-tier GraphQL fallback.

changelog.title: Smart Shuffle & Infinite Genre Automix
items: Fixed shuffle loop issue where single tracks repeated indefinitely: turning on shuffle now dynamically spins up an automix of similar genre and style tracks.
Fixed single-track queues by linking YouTube Automix radio (RDAMVM) and related genre tracks automatically across Search, Home, and Suggestions.
Seamless Autoplay: when reaching the end of a queue with Repeat Off, Pulse Wave automatically loads more tracks of the same genre so your music never abruptly stops.

changelog.title: Device Compatibility & Crash Fixes
items: Fixed critical ExceptionInInitializerError crash on Vivo, Honor, Motorola, Samsung, and Realme devices caused by font variation settings.
Fixed ConcurrentModificationException crash during dynamic Spotify recommendations background indexing.
Strengthened Proguard and R8 optimization keep rules for typography and serialization across all architectures.

changelog.title: Visual Engine & Cover Art Overhaul
items: Crystal-clear high-resolution album art: eliminated blurry/pixelated thumbnails across YouTube Music and Spotify feeds by dynamically serving up to 800x800 and 640x640 covers.
Smooth hero art tinting: removed pitch-black screen flashes when navigating into albums and artist pages.
Solid Apple Music-inspired elevated dock for keyboard search bar, eliminating distorted background shaders.

changelog.title: Audio Playback & Crossfade Polish
items: Instant crossfade activation: changes to crossfade toggles and duration now immediately apply to the actively playing song without requiring a track change or restart.
Optimized gapless transition detection.

changelog.title: Admin Panel Enhancements & Mashup Studio
items: Added real-time search filtering and status chips across all User Suggestions and Bug Reports.
One-tap Admin quick replies for rapid issue triaging ('Fixed in v6.1.1!', 'Investigating now', etc.).
Added Bug Report deletion support to keep issue queues clean and actionable.
New Mashup Studio (AI DJ Lab): interactive admin console to configure and preview real-time multi-track beat matching, stem isolation, and line-by-line / verse-by-verse transitions.
